name: aircrack-ng
purpose: Complete suite of tools to assess WiFi network security. Focuses on monitoring, attacking, testing, and cracking 802.11 WEP, WPA-PSK, and WPA2-PSK keys. Includes airmon-ng, airodump-ng, aireplay-ng, and packetforge-ng.
